attributes.board_name: Iowa Board of Behavioral Health Professionals (Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs sponsored/approved by ASWB ACE or NASW CEU approval program; coursework in listed social work content areas; academic courses (1 semester hr = 15 h); limited credit for teaching, presenting, authorship, practicum supervision, pre-approved pro bono work
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal; hours from initial licensure to the second renewal may be used.
rules.carryover: Up to 50% of excess CE may be carried into the next biennium.
rules.audit_note: A percentage of licensees is randomly audited after each renewal cycle; keep certificates (title, dates, hours, sponsor, name) for 4 years.

topics.who: Licensees who examine, attend, counsel or treat children in Iowa: HHS mandatory reporter training (2 h initial; renewal attests completion within previous 3 years)
Licensees who examine, attend, counsel or treat adults in Iowa: HHS dependent adult abuse mandatory reporter training within previous 3 years

rules.notes: CE compliance period Jan 1 of odd year to Dec 31 of next even year; license renewal period runs on the same dates. Hour = at least 50 minutes. Board does not pre-approve providers.
